projects.title: Auth0 Identity & Access Platform
projects.bodyText: Designed and implemented identity and access management on Auth0 for AVIV's platforms, serving 1M+ active users across user management, role-based access control, and third-party integrations. Owned security assessments and threat modeling for major features, identifying vulnerabilities and mitigations against established security standards. Took technical ownership of architecture decisions and code reviews while shipping maintainable microservices in Java and Node.js on AWS.

projects.title: AWS Migration & Cost Optimization
projects.bodyText: Led technical delivery of large-scale database and system migrations onto AWS, moving on-premises servers and PostgreSQL databases while safeguarding data integrity and minimizing downtime. Directed cloud architecture using Terraform, CloudFormation, and CDK, and contributed to a 10% reduction in AWS costs through targeted optimization. Coordinated across teams to integrate legacy systems and resolve complex technical challenges along the way.

projects.title: Logistics Microservices Platform
projects.bodyText: Designed and built microservices in a distributed system for outbound logistics at OTTO, Germany's largest online retailer for fashion, lifestyle, and home & living. Extended core Java-based projects within the Logistic Service team, and set up unit, CDC, integration, and functional test suites to keep the distributed system reliable. Managed infrastructure as code with Terraform and practiced DevOps on AWS as part of a Scrum team, shipping continuously to production.

projects.title: Security & Risk Management Analysis
projects.bodyText: Produced qualitative and quantitative risk assessments for a cyber-threat case study, pairing a structured risk register with quantitative modelling to make loss exposure defensible in numbers, not judgement. Built Monte Carlo simulations in Python to turn threat likelihood and impact into probability-of-loss exceedance curves, then applied TOPSIS decision analysis to rank mitigations — quantifying risk before designing controls around it.

projects.title: This Portfolio, Spec-Driven
projects.bodyText: Designed and built this site end-to-end using spec-driven development: every feature starts as a written spec and plan before a line of code is touched. Architecturally significant decisions are captured as ADRs (21 and counting) in docs/adr — from choosing JSON content over a CMS to the single-page story structure — keeping the reasoning behind the codebase as legible as the code itself. Built on Next.js 16, React 19, and TypeScript in strict mode, with content validated at runtime by Zod.
